title: Cruise Outbreaks Climbed As Ships Packed In Thousands
hook: One contagious illness keeps finding thousands of passengers in close quarters.
closing: On a crowded cruise, handwashing can interrupt thousands of possible close contacts.
question: Would outbreaks change your cruise pick?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, continuing a three-year rise.
Norovirus caused 15 outbreaks, so one contagious illness drove most recorded cases.
Some cruise ships carry 7,600 guests, multiplying the close contacts norovirus can exploit.
